name: PCD Collimation FAIL + Critical — AI Summary Email
description: When a system has PCD collimation_status FAIL and CT Critical indicators for the same sysid, summarize the PCD failure context with AI and email kate.lawrencegupta@elastic.co.

definition.name: PCD Collimation FAIL + Critical — AI Summary Email
definition.description: When a system has PCD collimation_status FAIL and CT Critical indicators for the same sysid, summarize the PCD failure context with AI and email kate.lawrencegupta@elastic.co.

with.sysid: {%- assign g = event.alerts[0].kibana.alert.grouping -%}{%- assign s = g.sysid -%}{%- if s == nil or s == '' -%}{%- assign s = g['sysid.keyword'] -%}{%- endif -%}{%- if s == nil or s == '' -%}{%- assign s = event.alerts[0].kibana.alert.context.sysid -%}{%- endif -%}{%- if s == nil or s == '' -%}{%- assign s = event.alerts[0].kibana.alert.rule.parameters.sysid -%}{%- endif -%}{{ s | strip }}

with.query:
FROM pcd_detector_lpp_honeycomb
| WHERE sysid.keyword == "{{ variables.sysid }}"
    AND collimation_status.keyword == "FAIL"
| EVAL failed_module_flag = CASE(is_failed_module == true, 1, 0)
| STATS
    module_docs = COUNT(*),
    failed_module_docs = SUM(failed_module_flag),
    max_bad_pixels = MAX(is_bad_count),
    latest_pcd = MAX(@timestamp)
  BY sysid.keyword, session_id.keyword, collimation.keyword, collimation_status.keyword
| SORT latest_pcd DESC
| LIMIT 50

FROM ct_sitedata_ext2_indicator_events_m*
| WHERE sysid.keyword == "{{ variables.sysid }}"
    AND TO_UPPER(indicator_severity.keyword) == "CRITICAL"
| KEEP @timestamp, sysid, event_type, indicator_severity, indicator_message,
       indicator_id, hospital, customer, productName, systype, machine_type,
       sw_version, exam_number, ifr_event_name, ifr_event_protocol_name,
       ifr_event_category
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 50

with.systype: {%- assign alert_sys = event.alerts[0].kibana.alert.grouping.systype -%}{%- if alert_sys and alert_sys != '' -%}{{ alert_sys | strip }}{%- endif -%}

with.instructions:
You are a CT detector / PCD field-service reliability analyst. An alert
fired for system "{{ variables.sysid }}".

Using the PCD failure summary rows and Critical indicator history:
1. Summarize the PCD / collimation failure: sessions, collimation values,
   failed modules, bad-pixel counts, and timing.
2. Summarize the Critical indicator pattern for this sysid (event types,
   key messages, protocols/categories if present).
3. Correlate PCD FAIL with Critical indicators on the same sysid: what
   clinical / subsystem risk does the combination imply?
4. Recommend concise next field actions (module swap, recalibration,
   LPP re-run, parts to stage, escalation).

Format with clear sections and bullet points for a field service manager.
If the PCD rows array is empty, say explicitly that no PCD FAIL documents
were found for this exact sysid in pcd_detector_lpp_honeycomb, and still
summarize Critical indicators. Do not invent PCD failure details.
Focus the email narrative on PCD failures when rows exist.

with.subject: PCD Collimation FAIL + Critical — AI Summary for {{ variables.sysid }}
